description: Brex is a spend platform with REST APIs for cards, expenses, payments, teams and travel.
auth_notes: User token created by an account admin in Settings > Developer, sent in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.
gate_detail: Quickstart assumes a Brex customer with admin access who creates a user token in dashboard Settings > Developer. MCP also needs an admin to accept the Developer API agreement. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Ten API groups including Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Fields, Onboarding, Payments, Team, Transactions, Travel and Webhooks, defined with OpenAPI.
mcp_notes: Beta Brex MCP server documented on developer.brex.com; OAuth or token access; no endpoint URL given in the sources.
blocker_detail: Credentials require being a Brex customer with account admin access; Developer API agreement must be accepted.

evidence.quote: This guide assumes you are a Brex customer with admin access to your dashboard.
[Webhooks API](/openapi/webhooks_api): Send real-time notifications based on events
An account admin or card admin must accept the Developer API agreement in **Settings → Developer**.
The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account

uncertainties: MCP server URL is not stated.
Whether a Brex account is free or paid is not stated.
